title: Howard University (Howard)
summary: Howard University (Howard) is a university in Washington. This entry compiles College Scorecard figures and related sources; UniRepository is not affiliated with Howard.

sections.heading: What Howard is known for
paragraphs: Howard University is a private nonprofit institution known for its diverse academic offerings and significant enrollment size, with an undergraduate population of 10,108 students. The university maintains a selective admission process, admitting approximately 41.34% of applicants. Howard is particularly recognized for its strong programs in business and health-related fields, which constitute about 15.53% and 13.06% of its academic programs, respectively. These areas reflect the university's commitment to preparing students for careers in critical sectors. As a private nonprofit university, Howard emphasizes both academic excellence and community engagement.

The total cost of attendance, which includes tuition as well as additional expenses such as fees, room, board, and other related costs, amounts to $54,630.
